model_flow.output_layout: N x num_ports x (2*seq_len) real-stacked float32
model_flow.loop_summary: 5 joint refinement stages; stage 1 maps 24 to 144, later stages map 144 to 144, and every stage ends with learned-dense residual correction.

nodes.name: mixed_signal
nodes.description: Real-stacked mixed input [real, imag].
nodes.why: The task provides one mixed complex sequence flattened into real and imaginary blocks.

nodes.name: normalized_input
nodes.description: Optional per-sample RMS normalization inside the model.
nodes.why: Normalization rescales values but does not change tensor width.

nodes.name: stage_1_input
nodes.description: Input to stage 1.
nodes.why: The first stage consumes the mixed signal width 24 directly.

nodes.name: stage_1_hidden_1
nodes.description: First hidden linear layer of stage 1.
nodes.why: The first affine layer of stage 1 maps width 24 to hidden width 64.

nodes.name: stage_1_hidden_1_relu
nodes.description: ReLU after the first hidden layer of stage 1.
nodes.why: ReLU is applied after every hidden linear layer and keeps the hidden shape unchanged.

nodes.name: stage_1_hidden_2
nodes.description: Additional hidden linear layer 2 of stage 1.
nodes.why: This affine layer keeps hidden width 64 inside stage 1.

nodes.name: stage_1_hidden_2_relu
nodes.description: ReLU after hidden layer 2 of stage 1.
nodes.why: ReLU is elementwise, so the hidden width stays the same.

nodes.name: stage_1_joint_output
nodes.description: Joint stage output before residual correction for stage 1.
nodes.why: The final affine layer of stage 1 maps hidden width 64 to expanded width 144 = num_ports * (2 * seq_len).

nodes.name: stage_1_port_features
nodes.description: Stage 1 output reshaped into one real-stacked port tensor per port.
nodes.why: The expanded width 144 is partitioned into 6 port blocks of width 24.

nodes.name: stage_1_residual_corrected
nodes.description: Learned-dense residual correction after stage 1.
nodes.why: Stage output is summed across ports, compared with the mixed input, and corrected with one learned dense per-port residual mask for that stage.

nodes.name: stage_1_flattened_output
nodes.description: Flattened stage 1 output passed to the next stage.
nodes.why: The per-port output is flattened back to one joint vector so the next stage can process all ports jointly again.

counting_assumptions: All counts are estimated for one forward pass of one sample; multiply by runtime batch size N for a first-order batch estimate.
MACs and multiply/add counts are counted from affine layers using scalar CPU-style arithmetic.
Bias accumulation is counted as additions inside the addition totals.
Normalization, activations, and residual corrections are included as estimated scalar ops where relevant.
Tensor reshapes, concatenations, indexing, and memory traffic are not counted as arithmetic FLOPs.
Latency depends on implementation and hardware; these counts are for fast complexity screening only.

summary.batch_scaling_rule: Multiply the per-sample counts by runtime batch size N for a first-order batch estimate.
